| description = The [[Sabertooths of Blackburrow]] have proven to be direct threats to the safety and security of [[Surefall Glade]] and its inhabitants. The hunters, especially, have taken to killing members of the [[Jaggedpine Treefolk]] and breaking their [[Jagged Pine Crook Staff]]s, compounding their other crimes of poaching and trespassing. [[Corun Finisc]] has offered a reward for anyone who can recover and return the broken halves of these staffs to him.

The first gnoll hunter placeholder spawns just to the west of [[Surefall Glade]] entrance. Upon spawning it will immediately start to wander southwards until it reaches the area just west of [[Blackburrow]] and then it will path back.  

The second hunter spawns in front of [[Blackburrow]] at (3478, -970). Its patrol sends it north, about halfway to the undead ruins, before it turns around and paths back to Blackburrow's entrance. 

Both spawns are on the standard 6:40 timer.  The gnoll hunter is an ''extremely'' rare spawn for both locations.

 10-17-2019 Nilbog updated this mob [https://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?p=2989133#post2989133]
